decision.observation: Deselected; 'UNIT NEEDS ORDERS' persists; turn still 2. The Eagle Warrior remains at the tile at ~0.44,0.31 north of the city near the lake. The unit seems fixed there. The coastal map shows the unit can't reach open water. The Eagle Warrior's position is on a small land tile that connects to the city's territory to the south.
decision.hypothesis: Given repeated failures to move/fortify via clicks, the game may simply require ending the turn. The '!' button is the next-unit selector. If only one unit needs orders, clicking the big blue '!' might cycle it. But there's no visible end-turn button. In Civ VI the end-turn button is the same circular button on far right (the big ornate one at bottom-right ~0.94,0.87). When no orders pending it shows 'next turn'. Since a unit always needs orders here, it never becomes end-turn. The unit's inability to move suggests the tile is landlocked/isolated. The unit at ~0.44,0.31 is actually the one tile 'above' the city that's a peninsula into the lake — maybe it's where it spawned and has 2/2 but all neighbors are the city tile (blocked by city). Let me try clicking the exact hex directly adjacent SE of the unit, which is the city's own tile — blocked. So the only non-city neighbor might be water. Hence stuck!
decision.memory: Unit boxed: south is city tile, north/east is lake. Only reachable via water. Thus cannot land-move. Need to end turn via a 'next turn' control. The ornate bottom-right button may become end-turn only when no unit selected. But unit always needs orders. Perhaps pressing the big blue '!' when a unit is selected repeatedly cycles then ends. Try clicking the ornate far-right circular button at very bottom-right ~0.965,0.86.
